MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 15
   C. 11
   D. 4

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 75

15. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

17. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 32

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

21. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 64

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
